top_categories.workout_context: Grassroots Gravel's Colorado rolling gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Grassroots Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
At Grassroots Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
At mile 60 of 113, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 113 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Grassroots Gravel's Colorado rolling, Local event forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 113 miles.
When someone attacks on Colorado rolling gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 113 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
113 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Varied gradients on Colorado rolling gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Grassroots Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
Tempo is Grassroots Gravel's race pace. The wattage you'll hold for 113 miles on Colorado rolling gravel. Train it until it's automatic.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Grassroots Gravel’s 113 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Grassroots Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on colorado rolling gravel to build confidence. Expect: colorado rolling, local event, mountain west gravel.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, G Spot, and Over Under to prepare you for 113 miles of colorado rolling gravel in Pueblo, Colorado.
